title: Paniculated
summary: PANIC'ULATED, a. Having branches variously subdivided; as a paniculate stem. 1. Having the flowers in panicles; as a paniculate inflorescence.

inlines.v: PANIC'ULATED, a. Having branches variously subdivided; as a paniculate stem. 1. Having the flowers in panicles; as a paniculate inflorescence.
